LESSON: WRITING 7.3.1 HAND WRITING

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.3: Writing 7.3.1 Hand Writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 7.3.1 Hand Writing, part of Strand 7 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: How do we keep our books clean?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 7.3.1 Hand Writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self – efficacy as learner acquires the ability to confidently write letters of the alphabets, syllables and 3 letter words.

● Creativity and imagination: exploration skills are developed as the learner creatively models letters of the alphabet.

Values:
● Responsibility as learner demonstrates resilience in writing, modelling, drawing and colouring letters of the alphabet.

● Unity: cooperation as learner interacts with others in striving to achieve the common goal of writing letters of the alphabet,

syllables and words.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Citizenship as learner begins to appreciate the sources of water in the immediate environment within their country.

Link to other Activity Areas:

Good hand writing is a skill necessary in all other activity areas for easy reading and comprehension.

Suggested Learning Resources: Adapted course books, signed audio visual clips, books, Flash cards, charts, pictures, word bank,

online resources, relevant digital devices.
